command.name: security key-manager external azure disable
command.description: This command is deprecated and may be removed in a future release. Use the security key-manager keystore disable command to disable the Azure Key Vault, and the security key-manager keystore delete command to delete its configuration instead. This command disables the Azure Key Vault (AKV) associated with the given Vserver and deletes its configuration. If the AKV is in use by ONTAP, it cannot be disabled. This command is not supported if AKV has not been enabled for the Vserver.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver on which the AKV is to be disabled.

example.p: The following example disables the AKV for Vserver v1.
example.screen: cluster-1::>security key-manager external azure disable -vserver v1
